description: Temurin GPG signing stage. Triggers sign_temurin_gpg downstream job, copies .sig files back into TARGET_DIR, and archives them. Gated on SIGN_ARTIFACTS being true.

parameterGroups.name: Stage Selections
parameterGroups.description: Boolean flags that control which pipeline stages are enabled.

parameters.name: SIGN_ARTIFACTS
parameters.description: Enable artifact signing. When true, triggers sign_temurin_gpg and archives the resulting .sig files.
